transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. I've been making a lot of careless mistakes lately because I'm really struggling to pay close attention to details, especially at work. It's becoming a real issue for me, so I wanted to get some help with it.
Have you struggled with these difficulties in paying attention since you were a child, or is this a relatively new change in your life?

This isn't a new change at all; I've actually struggled with these attention issues since I was a kid, definitely before the age of 12. However, they have become incredibly persistent and noticeable over the last year and seven months.
In addition to your struggles with attention, do you often find yourself feeling physically restless, fidgety, or prone to acting impulsively without thinking?

Yes, I definitely do. I'm constantly tapping my hands or feet and squirming in my seat because I just can't seem to sit still. I also have this persistent, uncomfortable inner sense of restlessness that makes it really hard to relax.

Do you find that these symptoms of inattention and restlessness cause significant problems in more than one area of your life, such as both at work and in your personal relationships or home environment?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I've mostly just been focused on how much it's affecting my work, so I haven't really thought about whether it's causing problems in other areas of my life.
When you are at home or socializing with friends, do you find that you frequently interrupt others, struggle to wait your turn, or have difficulty following through on tasks like household chores?
I don't really think I interrupt people or struggle to wait my turn when I'm with others. As for doing household chores, I'm not really sure if I have difficulty with that.
Can you recall if you often lose things necessary for tasks, or if you are frequently forgetful in your daily activities at home?
I don't think I lose things very often, and I wouldn't say I experience much forgetfulness in my daily routine. Those aren't really things I struggle with.
Besides the fidgeting and inner restlessness you mentioned, do you often find yourself talking excessively, or do you frequently feel driven to be 'on the go' as if you were powered by a motor?
No, I don't think I talk excessively or chatter too much. I also don't really feel like I'm constantly "on the go" or driven by a motor.
Do you find that your tendency to act impulsively or your difficulty staying still has resulted in you frequently making reckless decisions or taking unnecessary physical risks?
No, I don't think I make reckless decisions or take unnecessary physical risks. That isn't really something I struggle with.

Do you often find that you have difficulty sustaining your attention during long meetings or while reading lengthy documents, or do you frequently find your mind wandering when someone is speaking directly to you?

Yes, absolutely. I really struggle to sustain my attention during long meetings or when I'm trying to read through lengthy documents. My mind also wanders quite a bit, even when someone is speaking directly to me.
Do you often find that you avoid or strongly dislike tasks that require a high level of mental effort over a long period, such as preparing reports or completing complex paperwork?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really noticed whether I actively avoid those kinds of tasks, though I definitely struggle to stay focused once I actually start them.
